---
name: Feature request
about: An engine, an analysis, a check or a change to the report
labels: enhancement
---

**What you want to do, and what stops you today**


**Your data and setup**
Engine and acquisition (FragPipe DIA, DIA-NN, MaxQuant TMT, …), the design
(conditions, replicates, plexes, doses, time points), and whether you use
`ionomos analyze` or the watcher on an instrument PC.

**A reference to check it against**
Ionomos ports methods and tests them against the original tool (docs/VALIDATION.md).
Which tool, package or paper does this already, and which version?

**Licence**
If it needs a database or a program: its licence, and whether it may be
redistributed (docs/DECISIONS.md D36, D79).

Before opening: [docs/ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/nichfoster/ionomos/blob/master/docs/ROADMAP.md)
may already list it, and [docs/VISION.md](https://github.com/nichfoster/ionomos/blob/master/docs/VISION.md)
says what Ionomos is not.
